title: Initial library implementation
body:
Here's my start on the library. 

I haven't spent a whole lot of time on the testing, and I don't know if I'm headed the right direction on it at all. I don't like the way it's set up very much, but it is passing the race detector with lots of access to the Hub happening in parallel. If I spent more time on it I think the next thing I would do is focus on creating more parallel access to a Job.
